description: This course allows students to develop their research skills by working on a supervised project which will be laboratory based. It is a similar course to FST2288 but the topic will require a deeper understanding of food sciences. Students will work independently under close supervision of the supervisor.
preclusion: If undertaking an Undergraduate Degree THEN ( must not have completed FST3288R at a grade of at least D)
preclusionRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN (COURSES (1) FST3288R:D)
title: Advanced UROPS in Food Science & Technology I
